description: Source code for handling TRX firmware images, including functions for fixing headers, checksum validation, and memory mapping operations related to TRX firmware format.

methods.name: trx_fixup
methods.description: Fixes the TRX header checksum on a given MTD device.

methods.name: trx_check
methods.description: Validates a TRX firmware image against the device and header.

methods.name: mtd_fixtrx
methods.description: Fixes the TRX header in a firmware image stored on an MTD device.
